Initial public release of Video Generator Free — Generate Videos from Text or Images.

- Instantly generate 1080p MP4 videos from text or images without editing software.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG files (up to 200MB).
- Simple workflow: upload files or enter text, describe your needs, and get a downloadable video within 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic cloud-based processing with no local installation required.
- Session tokens and free credit system for new and anonymous users.
- Supports tracking credits, session state, and easy exporting.
- Built for content creators seeking fast, AI-powered video production.
